novelty.justification: The claim’s novel route is the mechanism that a “query-independent default-time anchor” and the “query-time signal are separately decodable directions” whose competition hides already-stored, year-correct facts, with recovery by “suppressing the default-anchor direction.” Searches using “LLM default time anchor query specified time residual stream,” “temporal knowledge activation steering stale facts,” and “internal clock temporal alignment language models” identify Gurnee and Tegmark’s Language Models Represent Space and Time and Set the Clock: Temporal Alignment of Pretrained Language Models as the closest work: they establish decodable temporal representations and temporal misalignment, while temporal-QA and knowledge-conflict work establishes failures under changing or conflicting facts. Moving from those results to two non-redundant causal signals whose magnitude imbalance predicts fact-level override—and selectively suppressing the prior rather than updating the fact—is a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although the probing and activation-steering tools themselves are standard, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
